hero_headline: Learn Thai the way it actually sounds
hero_subline: Langsi breaks down every Thai sentence word by word — with pronunciation, translation, and the context no phrasebook gives you.
romanization_method: Latin phonetics with tone marks (no IPA) — readable from minute one, even without Thai script.
language_specific_challenges: 5 tones completely change a word's meaning — Langsi marks every tone directly in the pronunciation.
No spaces between words in Thai script — Langsi automatically breaks sentences into learnable chunks.
Formal and casual registers differ sharply — Langsi shows both variants for every sentence.

feature_highlights.title: Sentence-by-sentence breakdown
feature_highlights.body: Every example sentence is broken into individual words with translation and pronunciation — the "Langsi Method".

feature_highlights.title: Leitner spaced repetition
feature_highlights.body: Cards resurface right when you're about to forget them — backed by cognitive science.

feature_highlights.title: Three practice modes
feature_highlights.body: Flashcards, multiple choice, and listening train reading, recognition, and comprehension together.

feature_highlights.title: Real pronunciation
feature_highlights.body: Every word and sentence is spoken aloud right in your browser — no extra app needed.

faq.q: Do I need to know Thai script first?
faq.a: No. Everything is also shown in Latin phonetics with tone marks.

faq.q: How many words does the English-Thai course cover?
faq.a: Over 570 actively enriched words, ranked by everyday relevance and difficulty.

faq.q: How is Langsi different from a regular flashcard app?
faq.a: Langsi shows full sentence context and register (formal/casual), not just isolated word translations.
Yes, with a free starting tier.
